svg.text: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8 · 5 flex + 4 SS49E Hall (analog, ADC1) · MPU6050 + OLED on I2C · MAX98357A I2S speaker amp · pins from firmware/glove_unit/config.h
FLEX SENSORS (2.2" / 4.5" Spectra-type) 3V3 -> flex -> pin -> 47 kΩ -> GND
SS49E LINEAR HALL SENSORS (magnets on fingertips) OUT -> ADC
MPU6050 AD0 -> GND (address 0x68). GY-521 has its own pull-ups.
• Only ADC1 pins are used for sensors (ADC2 is unreliable).
• Run the flex/Hall wires along the fingers with strain relief.
i2c_scan, speaker_test. Then calibrate: hold BOOT 2 s.
5V tag -> glove 5V pin and MAX98357A VIN.
Never plug USB and the 5V boost in at the same time without a diode.
